title: Tool&N!
description: Forge survival modpack combining automation, food expansions, and performance optimizations for an immersive and smooth long-term gameplay experience.
body:
中文：
以 Create 6 為核心的 Forge 生存整合包，融合自動化工業、食物拓展與效能優化，帶來流暢且沉浸的長期遊玩體驗。

English:
A Forge survival modpack centered on Create 6, combining automation, food expansion, and performance optimization for a smooth and immersive long-term gameplay experience.
